15800.meaning1: having the precondition for; with the prerequisite for

examples.text: sīlavato, bhikkhave, sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi, sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūta-ñāṇadassana-sampannassa upanisasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo, nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.

15802.grammar: fem, abstr, in comps, from upanissayati (+dat)

examples.text: sace, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, sambodhipakkhikānaṃ, āvuso, dhammānaṃ kā upanisā bhāvanāyā'ti, evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ kin'ti byākareyyāthā'ti?
yam'pi'ssa taṃ, bhikkhave, khayasmiṃ khayeññāṇaṃ, tam'pi saupanisaṃ vadāmi, no anupanisaṃ. kā ca, bhikkhave, khayeñāṇassa upanisā? vimuttī'ti'ssa vacanīyaṃ.
ye te, bhikkhave, kusalā dhammā ariyā niyyānikā sambodhagāmino, tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ariyānaṃ niyyānikānaṃ sambodhagāmīnaṃ kā upanisā savanāyā'ti
aññā hi lābha-upanisā, aññā nibbānagāminī, evam'etaṃ abhiññāya, bhikkhu buddhassa sāvako, sakkāraṃ n'ābhinandeyya, vivekam'anubrūhaye.
etadatthā, bhikkhave, kathā, etadatthā mantanā, etadatthā upanisā, etadatthaṃ sot'āvadhānaṃ, yadidaṃ anupādā cittassa vimokkho'ti.
nisajjaṃ kappeyyā'ti mātugāme nisinne bhikkhu upanisinno vā hoti upanipanno vā. bhikkhu nisinne mātugāmo upanisinno vā hoti upanipanno vā. ubho vā nisinnā honti ubho vā nipannā.

15806.meaning1: who is seated close-by; who is sitting near
15806.construction:
upa + ni + sīda + na + ka
upanisinna + ka

15807.meaning1: Dhamma talk delivered to someone close at hand
15807.commentary: (ANt) attano santikaṃ upagantvā nisinnassa kātabbā tadanucchavikā dhammakathā upanisinnakakathā.

15809.meaning2: Chapter 4 of the Rādhasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 3 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: yadā kho te, bhikkhave, chappāṇakā jhattā assu kilantā, atha tam'eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upatiṭṭheyyuṃ, upanisīdeyyuṃ, upanipajjeyyuṃ.

so gacchati ce'pi tam'eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upagacchati. tiṭṭhati ce'pi tam'eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upatiṭṭhati. nisīdati ce'pi tam'eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upanisīdati. nipajjati ce'pi tam'eva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upanipajjati.

15811.grammar: abs of caus of upa ni √sad, caus, trans (+acc)

examples.text: atha kho ambaṭṭho māṇavo bhīto saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto bhagavantaṃ'y'eva tāṇaṃ gavesī bhagavantaṃ'y'eva leṇaṃ gavesī bhagavantaṃ'y'eva saraṇaṃ gavesī, upanisīditvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, kim'etaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo āha? punabhavaṃ gotamo bravitū'ti.
s'āssa māluvālatā taruṇā mudukā lomasā vilambinī, sā taṃ sālaṃ upaniseveyya.

15816.meaning1: decisive support; supporting condition; sufficient condition
15816.commentary: (ADha) upanissayapaccayo'ti idha pana ayaṃ tāva vacan'attho, tadadhīnavuttitāya attano phalena nissito, na paṭikkhitto'ti nissayo. yathā pana bhuso āyāso upāyāso, evaṃ bhuso nissayo upanissayo. balavakāraṇass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tasmā balavakāraṇabhāvena upakārako dhammo upanissayapaccayo'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: nissayapaccayo, upanissayapaccayo, purejātapaccayo, pacchājātapaccayo, āsevanapaccayo, kammapaccayo, vipākapaccayo, āhārapaccayo

15818.meaning1: having the supporting conditions; with requisite preconditions

examples.text: ceto paricca manas'ākāsī'ti tassā parisāya cittaṃ paccekaṃ paricchinditvā manasi akāsi te volokesi. bhabbo dhammaṃ viññātun'ti maggaphaladhammaṃ adhigantuṃ samattho, upanissayasampanno'ti attho.

15819.meaning1: due to decisive support; because of being a necessary supporting condition
15819.meaningLit: by the power of nearby support

examples.text: akusalakammabhavassa upanissayavasena'pi sahajāt'ādi-vasena'pi. upapattibhavassa pana sabbassā'pi upanissayavasen'eva.
bhikkhu pan'eva aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, tassa kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti c'eva suyyanti ca, kulāni ca tena duṭṭhāni dissanti c'eva suyyanti ca
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satthāraṃ upanissāya viharati aññataraṃ vā garuṭṭhāniyaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ, yatth'assa tibbaṃ hir'ottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti pemañ'ca gāravo ca.
tenah'ānanda, yāvatikā bhikkhū vesāliṃ upanissāya viharanti te sabbe upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannipātehī'ti.
yaṃnūna mayaṃ amuṃ nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ nevāpikassa upanissāya āsayaṃ kappeyyāma.

15823.meaning1: dependent on; clinging to; relying on

examples.text: ete ca ñatvā upanissitā'ti, ñatvā munī nissaye so vimaṃsī, ñatvā vimutto na vivādam'eti, bhav'ābhavāya na sameti dhīro'ti.

15824.synonym: abbajati, āgacchati, pacceti, paṭikkamati, punarāgamati, punupeti

examples.text: alatthaṃ yadidaṃ sādhu, n'ālatthaṃ kusalaṃ iti. ubhayen'eva so tādī, rukkhaṃ'v'upanivattati.

15825.commentary: (SNa) jar'ūpanītassā'ti jaraṃ upagatassa, jarāya vā maraṇasantikaṃ upanītassa.

examples.text: kāmesu giddhā pasutā pamūḷhā, avadāniyā te visame niviṭṭhā, dukkha-upanītā paridevayanti, kiṃsū bhavissāma ito cutāse.
sīl'uttamā saññamen'āhu suddhiṃ, vataṃ samādāya upaṭṭhitāse, idh'eva sikkhema ath'assa suddhiṃ, bhava-upanītā kusalā vadānā.

15826.commentary: (SNa) thūṇ'ūpanītānī'ti thūṇaṃ upanītāni, thūṇāya baddhāni honti. (SNt) upanītāni yaññaṃ yajituṃ ārambhāya.

examples.text: saccena danto damasā upeto, ved'antagū vusitabrahmacariyo, yañño-upanīto tam'upavhayetha, kālena so juhati dakkhiṇeyye'ti.

tena kho pana samayena rañño pasenadissa kosalassa mahāyañño paccupaṭṭhito hoti, pañca ca usabhasatāni pañca ca vacchatarasatāni pañca ca vacchatarisatāni pañca ca ajasatāni pañca ca urabbhasatāni thūṇā-upanītāni honti yaññ'atthāya.

yāvañ'c'idaṃ bhoto gotamassa evaṃ āsajja āsajja vuccamānassa, upanītehi vacanappathehi samudācariyamānassa, chavivaṇṇo c'eva pariyodāyati, mukhavaṇṇo ca vippasīdati, yathā taṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
sara catur'odadhī, upanīte assuthaññarudhiramhi, sara ekakappam'aṭṭhīnaṃ, sañcayaṃ vipulena samaṃ.

15829.commentary: (DHPa) upanītavayo'ti upā'ti nipātamattaṃ, nītavayo'ti vigatavayo atikkantavayo, tvañ'c'asi dāni tayo vaye atikkamitvā maraṇamukhe ṭhito'ti attho.

examples.text: upanītavayo ca dāni'si, sampayāto'si yamassa santike, vāso te n'atthi antarā, pātheyyam'pi ca te na vijjati.

15830.meaning1: trained; instructed; initiated (in); (comm) caused to reach
15830.commentary: (MNa) upanītā kho me tumhe'ti mayā, bhikkhave, tumhe iminā sandiṭṭhik'ādisabhāvena dhammena nibbānaṃ upanītā, pāpitā'ti attho.

examples.text: sādhu, bhikkhave, upanītā kho me tumhe, bhikkhave, iminā sandiṭṭhikena dhammena akālikena ehipassikena opaneyyikena paccattaṃ veditabbena viññūhi.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, assalāyana, idh'āssu dve māṇavakā bhātaro saudariyā, eko ajjhāyako upanīto eko anajjhāyako anupanīto. kam'ettha brāhmaṇā paṭhamaṃ bhojeyyuṃ saddhe vā thālipāke vā yaññe vā pāhune vā'ti?

15831.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

15832.meaning1: at the end of life; come to the last stage of life
15832.commentary: (DHPa) upanītavayo'ti upā'ti nipātamattaṃ, nītavayo'ti vigatavayo atikkantavayo, tvañ'c'asi dāni tayo vaye atikkamitvā maraṇamukhe ṭhito'ti attho.

examples.text: upanītavayo ca dāni'si, sampayāto'si yamassa santike, vāso te n'atthi antarā, pātheyyam'pi ca te na vijjati.

15833.commentary: (MNa) āsajja upanīyā'ti guṇe ghaṭṭetvā c'eva upanetvā ca.

examples.text: addhā kho te ayaṃ, aggivessana, āsajja upanīya vācā bhāsitā, api ca te ahaṃ byākarissāmi.

15834.meaning1: is carried away; is led to the end; is brought to a conclusion; (comm) slowly approaches death
15834.meaning2: is brought up to, is carried away
15834.commentary: (SNa) upanīyatī'ti parikkhīyati nirujjhati, upagacchati vā, anupubbena maraṇaṃ upetī'ti attho

examples.text: upanīyati jīvitam'appam'āyu, jar'ūpanītassa na santi tāṇā, etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno, puññāni kayirātha sukh'āvahānī'ti.

15835.meaning1: is led on; is driven on (by)
15835.commentary: (ANa) upanīyatī'ti upasaṃharīyati. ayaṃ hi jātiyā jaraṃ upanīyati, jarāya byādhiṃ, byādhinā maraṇaṃ, maraṇena puna jātiṃ. tena vuttaṃ, upanīyatī'ti.

examples.text: upanīyati kho ayaṃ, brāhmaṇā, loko jarāya byādhinā maraṇena. evaṃ upanīyamāne kho, brāhmaṇā, loke jarāya byādhinā maraṇena, yo idha kāyena saṃyamo vācāya saṃyamo manasā saṃyamo, taṃ tassa petassa tāṇañ'ca leṇañ'ca dīpañ'ca saraṇañ'ca parāyaṇañ'cā'ti.

15836.meaning1: being led on; being driven on (by)
15836.commentary: (ANa) upanīyatī'ti upasaṃharīyati. ayaṃ hi jātiyā jaraṃ upanīyati, jarāya byādhiṃ, byādhinā maraṇaṃ, maraṇena puna jātiṃ. tena vuttaṃ, upanīyatī'ti.

examples.text: upanīyati kho ayaṃ, brāhmaṇā, loko jarāya byādhinā maraṇena. evaṃ upanīyamāne kho, brāhmaṇā, loke jarāya byādhinā maraṇena, yo idha kāyena saṃyamo vācāya saṃyamo manasā saṃyamo, taṃ tassa petassa tāṇañ'ca leṇañ'ca dīpañ'ca saraṇañ'ca parāyaṇañ'cā'ti.

15838.meaning1: (of money) to produce; to come up with

examples.text: so kismiñci'd'eva dhanakaraṇīye samuppanne na sakkuṇeyya upanīhātuṃ dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā.

15839.meaning1: could be assumed; could be supposed

examples.text: attano bhātiṭṭhāne bhātaraṃ sahāyaṭṭhāne sahāyaṃ parikkhāraṭṭhāne vā parikkhāran'ti kismiñci ṭhāne parassa attānaṃ iminā kiñcanabhāvena upanetabbaṃ na passatī'ti attho.
idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa appamattakam'pi pāpakammaṃ kataṃ tam'enaṃ nirayaṃ upaneti.
atha khv'assa pubb'eva tathā cittaṃ bhāvitaṃ hoti yaṃ taṃ tath'attāya upanetī'ti.
att'upanāyikan'ti te vā kusale dhamme attani upaneti attānaṃ vā tesu kusalesu dhammesu upaneti.

15842.meaning1: to lead; to carry; to guide (to)

examples.text: yathā hi mugga-māsa-ppamāṇā'pi pāsāṇasakkharā udake pakkhittā uppilavamānā nāma n'atthi, ek'antaṃ heṭṭhā'va pavisati, evam'evaṃ antamaso sakkāyadiṭṭhi'pi saggaṃ upanetuṃ samatthā nāma n'atthi, ek'antaṃ apāyesu'y'eva nimujjāpetī'ti.
te sāvake upanetvā pabbajite, sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desetvā pabbajitānaṃ, sāvakesu gedhitacittā pabbajitesu, kāyassa bhedā pāṇ'upacchedā hīne kāye patiṭṭhitā.

desento'pi hi, pāpima, tathāgato sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ tādiso'va, adesento'pi hi, pāpima, tathāgato sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ tādiso'va. upanento'pi hi, pāpima, tathāgato sāvake tādiso'va, anupanento'pi hi, pāpima, tathāgato sāvake tādiso'va.

15845.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: dve jālino munino aṭṭhako ca, atha kosallo buddho atho subāhu, upanemiso nemiso santacitto, sacco tatho virajo paṇḍito ca.

15846.commentary: (DNa) amhe'pi evaṃ upaneyya upaneyyā'ti brāhmaṇo kho pana ambaṭṭha pokkharasātī'ti-ādīni vatvā evaṃ upanetvā upanetvā paṭicchannaṃ kāraṇaṃ āvikaritvā suṭṭhu dās'ādibhāvaṃ āropetvā avaca, tayā amhe akkosāpitā'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: yadeva kho tvaṃ, ambaṭṭha, taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ āsajja āsajja avacāsi, atha kho so bhavaṃ gotamo amhe'pi evaṃ upaneyya upaneyya avaca.
nanu tvaṃ, bhikkhu, passasi brahmaparisaṃ sannipatitan'ti? iti kho maṃ, bhikkhave, māro pāpimā brahmaparisaṃ upanesi.

15848.commentary: (MNa) mā sāvake upanesī'ti gihisāvake vā pabbajitasāvake vā taṃ dhammaṃ mā upanayasi.

examples.text: sace kho tvaṃ, mārisa, evaṃ pajānāsi, sace tvaṃ evaṃ anubuddho, mā sāvake upanesi, mā pabbajite, mā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesi, mā pabbajitānaṃ, mā sāvakesu gedhim'akāsi, mā pabbajitesu.
ahesuṃ kho, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā paṭijānamānā. te sāvake upanesuṃ pabbajite, sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesuṃ pabbajitānaṃ, sāvakesu gedhim'akaṃsu pabbajitesu

15853.commentary: (NPt) diṭṭhe vā dhamme attabhāve, upapajje vā anantarabhave, apare vā pariyāye bhave deti nibbattetī'ti evaṃ phalanibbattakasaṅkhāraṃ vā taṃsampayuttaṃ taṇhaṃ vā bhagavā āha.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, kammānaṃ vipāko? tividh'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, kammānaṃ vipākaṃ vadāmi, diṭṭh'eva dhamme, upapajje vā, apare vā pariyāye. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, kammānaṃ vipāko.

15854.commentary: (NPt) evaṃ imāya tividhāya saṅkhāracetanāya sampayuttā tividhā taṇhā tividhaṃ phalaṃ diṭṭhe vā dhamme attabhāve, upapajje vā anantarabhave, apare vā pariyāye bhave deti nibbattetī'ti evaṃ phalanibbattakasaṅkhāraṃ vā taṃsampayuttaṃ taṇhaṃ vā bhagavā āha.

examples.text: tena so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati. yañ'ca kho so idha pāṇ'ātipātī hoti adinn'ādāyī hoti… micchādiṭṭhi hoti tassa diṭṭh'eva dhamme vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti upapajja vā apare vā pariyāye.
atha v'āssa agārāni, aggi ḍahati pāvako, kāyassa bhedā duppañño, nirayaṃ so-upapajjati.
yattha nu kho, bhante, na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na upapajjati, sakkā nu kho so, bhante, gamanena lokassa anto ñātuṃ vā daṭṭhuṃ vā pāpuṇituṃ vā'ti?

15856.synonym: nibbattati, pabhavati, vuppajjati, sañjāyati, samudayati, samudeti

examples.text: chinda sotaṃ parakkamma, kāme panuda brāhmaṇa, nappahāya munī kāme, n'ekattam'upapajjati.

15857.meaning1: is suitable; is acceptable; is admissible

examples.text: cakkhu attā'ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati. cakkhussa uppādo'pi vayo'pi paññāyati.

15860.commentary: (VINa) cavamāne upapajjamāne'ti ettha cutikkhaṇe vā upapattikkhaṇe vā dibbacakkhunā daṭṭhuṃ na sakkā, ye pana āsannacutikā idāni cavissanti te cavamānā. ye ca gahitapaṭisandhikā sampatinibbattā vā, te upapajjamānā'ti adhippetā. te evarūpe cavamāne upapajjamāne ca passāmī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: so sace ākaṅkhati, dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passeyyaṃ cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe, sugate duggate yathākamm'ūpage satte pajāneyyaṃ
m'āyaṃ āyasmā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjī'ti! evaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo.

atha kho, pāpima, kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho nāg'āpalokitaṃ apalokesi, na v'āyaṃ dūsī māro mattam'aññāsī'ti. sah'āpalokanāya ca pana, pāpima, dūsī māro tamhā ca ṭhānā cavi mahānirayañ'ca upapajji.

15862.meaning2: (from upapajjati) who comes into existence, is reborn (in)

examples.text: abhijānām'ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, evarūpaṃ yaññaṃ yajitvā vā yājetvā vā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjitā, ahaṃ tena samayena purohito brāhmaṇo ahosiṃ tassa yaññassa yājetā'ti.

tena so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati. yañ'ca kho so idha pāṇ'ātipātī hoti adinn'ādāyī hoti… micchādiṭṭhi hoti tassa diṭṭh'eva dhamme vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti upapajjitvā vā apare vā pariyāye.
evam'eva kho, mahārāja, idh'ekacco puggalo akusalaṃ kammaṃ cetanāya cetayitvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyya.
bhagavā pana, bhante, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pahoti tathā kātuṃ yathā sabbo loko kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyā'ti?
n'eva pubbenivāsāya, na'pi dibbassa cakkhuno, cetopariyāya iddhiyā, cutiyā upapattiyā, sotadhātuvisuddhiyā, paṇidhī me na vijjati.
sa kho so, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, na kho ahaññ'ev'eko jarādhammo jaraṃ anatīto, atha kho yāvatā sattānaṃ āgati gati cuti upapatti sabbe sattā jarādhammā jaraṃ anatītā'ti.

15866.meaning1: appearance; occasion; occurrence; happening; taking place

examples.text: ahi vicchikā satapadī nakulā biḷārā mūsikā ulūkā, ye vā pan'aññe'pi keci tiracchānayonikā sattā manusse disvā saṃsappanti. iti kho, bhikkhave, bhūtā bhūtassa upapatti hoti. yaṃ karoti tena upapajjati.

15868.meaning1: having a certain type of rebirth; with a certain destination

examples.text: jimhagatikassa kho pan'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, jimh'upapattikassa dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi, ye vā ek'antadukkhā nirayā yā vā saṃsappajātikā tiracchānayoni.

15870.meaning1: which leads to acquiring rebirth; related to re-arising
15870.meaning2: leading to the obtaining of rebirth, or a new existence
15870.commentary: (ANa) upapattipaṭilābhiyānī'ti yehi anantarā upapattiṃ paṭilabhati. bhavapaṭilābhiyānī'ti upapattibhavassa paṭilābhāya paccayāni.

examples.text: katame cattāro? idha, bhikkhave, ekaccassa puggalassa oram'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni appahīnāni honti, upapattipaṭilābhiyāni saṃyojanāni appahīnāni honti, bhavapaṭilābhiyāni saṃyojanāni appahīnāni honti.

15871.meaning1: danger of rebirth; peril of reappearance

examples.text: sahassaṃ brahmalokānaṃ, mahābrahm'ābhitiṭṭhati, upapanno jutimanto, bhismākāyo yasassiso.

ty'āhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi, api pana tumhe āyasmanto yā tā devatā ek'antasukhaṃ lokaṃ upapannā, tāsaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ saddaṃ suṇātha, suppaṭipannāttha, mārisā, ujuppaṭipannāttha, mārisā, ek'antasukhassa lokassa sacchikiriyāya
avihaṃ upapannāse, vimuttā satta bhikkhavo, rāgadosaparikkhīṇā, tiṇṇā loke visattikan'ti.
santi loke munayo, janā vadanti ta'y'idaṃ kathaṃsu, ñāṇa-upapannaṃ no muniṃ vadanti, udāhu ve jīvitena-upapannaṃ.
apissu taṃ jano disvā evam'āha, abhirūpo vata, bho, rañño nāgo, dassanīyo vata, bho, rañño nāgo, pāsādiko vata, bho, rañño nāgo, kāy'upapanno vata, bho, rañño nāgo'ti!

15879.meaning1: laden with fruit; full of fruit

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, gahapati, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre tibbo vanasaṇḍo. tatr'assa rukkho sampannaphalo ca upapannaphalo ca, na c'assu kānici phalāni bhūmiyaṃ patitāni.

15880.meaning1: explores; examines; investigates; inspects; inquires; looks (into)
15880.synonym: upadhāreti, upavicarati, oloketi, tīreti, paṭivicarati, pavicarati, pavicinati, passati, vicāreti, vicināti, vīmaṃsati, voloketi, samannesati, samanvesati

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhante, cetaso bhikkhu dabbajātiko, yato yato imassa dhammapariyāyassa paññāya atthaṃ upaparikkheyya, labheth'eva attamanataṃ, labheth'eva cetaso pasādaṃ
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhātuso upaparikkhati, āyatanaso upaparikkhati, paṭiccasamuppādaso upaparikkhati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tividh'ūpaparikkhī hoti.

15882.synonym: pavicinanta, vicinanta, vīmaṃsamāna, volokenta, samannesanta, samannesamāna, samanvesanta

examples.text: tassa taṃ passato nijjhāyato yoniso upaparikkhato rittakaññ'eva khāyeyya, tucchakaññ'eva khāyeyya, asārakaññ'eva khāyeyya.
tesaṃ te dhammā paññāya atthaṃ upaparikkhataṃ nijjhānaṃ khamanti.

sā'pi nāma, bhikkhave, payirupāsanā n'āhosi, tam'pi nāma, bhikkhave, sot'āvadhānaṃ n'āhosi, tam'pi nāma, bhikkhave, dhammassavanaṃ n'āhosi, sā'pi nāma, bhikkhave, dhammadhāraṇā n'āhosi, sā'pi nāma, bhikkhave, attha-upaparikkhā n'āhosi

15886.commentary: (SNa) mā te saṅgho uttari upaparikkhī'ti mā bhikkhusaṅgho atireka-okāse taṃ upaparikkhī'ti. idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti, ānandena buddhapaṭibhāgo sāvako vārito, ekā bhikkhunī na vāritā, tāya saddhiṃ santhavo vā sineho vā bhavissatī'ti mā taṃ saṅgho evaṃ amaññī'ti.

examples.text: khama, bhante kassapa, bālo mātugāmo'ti. āgamehi tvaṃ, āvuso ānanda, mā te saṅgho uttari upaparikkhi.

15887.meaning1: should be examined; should be explored; should be considered
15887.meaningLit: should be looked all around near

examples.text: tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā tesaṃ vitakkānaṃ ādīnavo upaparikkhitabbo.
attadīpānaṃ, bhikkhave, viharataṃ attasaraṇānaṃ anaññasaraṇānaṃ, dhammadīpānaṃ dhammasaraṇānaṃ anaññasaraṇānaṃ yoni upaparikkhitabbā.

15889.meaning2: to investigate; to inspect; to inquire; to look (into); to examine

15890.meaning1: having examined; having enquired (into); having investigated
15890.meaning2: having investigated; having inspected; having inquired (into); having examined

examples.text: vatthuvijj'ācariyo viya hi bhagavā. so yathā vatthuvijj'ācariyo nagarabhūmiṃ passitvā suṭṭhu upaparikkhitvā ettha nagaraṃ māpethā'ti upadisati, sotthinā ca nagare niṭṭhite rājakulato mahāsakkāraṃ labhati
sattaṭṭhānakusalo, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tividh'ūpaparikkhī imasmiṃ dhammavinaye kevalī vusitavā uttamapuriso'ti vuccati.

idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, sutānañ'ca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti, dhātānañ'ca dhammānaṃ atth'ūpaparikkhī hoti attham'aññāya dhammam'aññāya, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno hoti.
sattānaṃ cuta-upapāta-ñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ

15894.commentary: (ANa) sabbo so na upapādetī'ti sabbo'pi so kusaladhammaṃ na uppādeti, attano vā vacanaṃ upapādetuṃ anucchavikaṃ kātuṃ na sakkoti.

examples.text: ahañ'hi, bhante, evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi, yo koci par'ūpārambhaṃ vatteti, par'ūpārambhaṃ vattento sabbo so na upapādeti. anupapādento gārayho hoti upavajjo'ti.

15895.construction:
upa + para > pāra + ma + *ī
upa + parama + *ī
15895.commentary: (KNa) tattha dānapāramiyaṃ tāva bāhirabhaṇḍapariccāgo pāramī nāma, aṅgapariccāgo upapāramī nāma, jīvitapariccāgo param'atthapāramī nāmā'ti.

examples.text: dasa pāramī tayā dhīra, kīdisī lokanāyaka, kathaṃ upapāramī puṇṇā, param'atthapāramī kathaṃ.
